content_variants.text:
During crossing of Russian convoy | Turkish forces shell positions in northern countryside of Aleppo and hit Russian armoured vehicle

Aleppo province: Earlier today, Turkish forces fired heavy artillery shells on positions on the road of Mazarea Um Hosh-Harbel in the northern countryside of Aleppo, within areas controlled by Kurdish and regime forces, during the passing of a Russian convoy in the region, where a shell hit an armoured vehicle and damaged it. No causalities were reported.
Mazarea Um Hosh-Harbel is considered as lines of contacts between areas controlled by Kurdish and regime forces on one hand, and “Euphrates Shield” areas on the other hand, in the opposite side of Marea city in the northern countryside of Aleppo.
Yesterday, SOHR reported that Turkish forces and their proxies fired heavy artillery shells on the vicinity of Tel Refaat city, Abin, Kashta’ar, Mara’anaz, Tatimrash, Al-Malkiya, Soghanka and Herasha in Shirawa district in Afrin countryside within areas of Kurdish and regime forces in northern Aleppo countryside. However, no casualties have been reported yet.
This comes after an attack on two bases of Turkish forces in Aleppo countryside.
